== Course of events ==

Having grown suspicious of how easily the group progressed toward the palace, and after arguing that General Jinjur was rightfully Queen with no claim held over her palace, the Scarecrow declares that they cannot stay shut in the palace and calls for a plan of escape. The declaration follows a period of quiet thought, during which the Scarecrow had already begun weighing how the group might leave the building, an idea that leads him to propose building a flying machine on the roof, to be animated with the Powder of Life and built by the Tin Woodman.

In the aftermath of the declaration, the Scarecrow removes his crown and sets it aside, reflecting that General Jinjur may now claim it. The group disperses to gather materials for the aerial machine, while the Tin Woodman repairs Jack Pumpkinhead's broken leg with a table leg. Amid these preparations, the Woggle-Bug and Jack Pumpkinhead voice their fear of being eaten, recalling General Jinjur's threat to turn them into tarts, goulash, or soup.
